correctness.rationale: For C_k=mu^k(1) with mu(1)=101 and mu(0)=000, the ternary carry gap identity enumerates all zero-block period-one runs. The paired-one residue obstruction forces any square with a one to have period 2*3^j; block-aligned maximal endpoints and exact inflation reduce all such runs to the unique maximal period-two windows about 101 images. This reconstructs every run interval/least period, counts 3*2^(k-1)-3 and length 4*3^k-13*2^(k-1)+1 for all k>=1. Independent direct least-period interval enumeration k=1..5 matched construction, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Bounded finite experiments do not prove unrestricted quantification; proof reconstruction includes stated critical lemmas.
